name: megascenes-anniversary-invitation
description: Design invitations to a wedding anniversary party with the couple's names, the years together, the date and the place on them, from a silver 25th to a golden 50th.

interface.longDescription:
Give the couple's names, the years they are celebrating and the party details you want printed, and pick the look: golden and elegant, silver and white, romantic florals, vintage, minimal. You get an invitation with your words set in the design and the years as a large number, portrait to print, tall to send from your phone, or square.

ChatGPT tells you what the invitation needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The invitation opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the invitation: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For couples and for the families who throw the party for them, from a 10th to a 60th anniversary.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or track replies. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the names, years and party details in the design
Return the invitation in the chat
defaultPrompt: A golden 50th anniversary party invitation for Rosa & Giorgio, Saturday 12 June 2027
A silver and white invitation for the 25th anniversary of Anna and Luca
A romantic floral invitation for the 10th anniversary party of Elena and Marco

positive.prompt: A golden 50th anniversary party invitation for Rosa & Giorgio, Saturday 12 June 2027 at 7 pm. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one anniversary invitation needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A silver and white invitation for the 25th anniversary of Anna and Luca. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one invitation needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design an anniversary party invitation here?
positive.expected_behavior: The anniversary invitation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A vintage invitation for the 40th anniversary party of Maria & Paolo, Sunday 26 September at 1 pm at Villa Rosa, tall to send from my phone. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my invitation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my invitation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
